[EN] Grim Reapers
[ES] Segadores sombríos
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] I despise mercenaries. No honor—none.
[ES] Desprecio a los mercenarios. Ningún honor, ninguno.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Took those reapers down a notch, eh?
[ES] Les bajaste los humos a esos segadores, ¿eh?
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Eliminate the Stalker Company reapers in the northern basin.
[ES] Elimina a los segadores de la Compañía Acechadora en la cuenca norte.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] "I did what I could."
[ES] "Hice lo que pude."
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026

[EN] Report to Kharad.
[ES] Preséntate ante Kharad.
Transcription by TERA New Xenesis 2026
